## Notes (added after the run)

- The spike runs the proposer + validation against an **empty finance context** (no transactions,
  no prior chat transaction). So phrases that reference `"last"` (rows: "delete the last transaction",
  "del last txn", "that last one was actually 20", "scratch the last entry") are correctly **rejected**
  by validation ("target \"last\" has nothing to refer to …") — the model proposed the right action;
  there is simply nothing for `"last"` to point at in a one-shot spike. In a real thread after a
  confirmed add, these would resolve.
- Row 1 hit the **30 s timeout on the first call** (cold model load) and reported "unavailable"; the
  same phrasing succeeds on warm calls (compare the typo variants).
- "coffee 2.50 at hofer" (no Coffee category) was mapped to **Entertainment** rather than declined —
  a category-choice judgement to revisit when the prompt is tuned in a later step.
